title: Find a schematic component and zoom to it
summary: Iterates the components of the active schematic sheet to find one by designator and centres the view on it by running the SCH:Zoom process with internal coordinates.
phrasings: locate a part by designator on a schematic
zoom the schematic view to a component
iterate components on the active sheet

commands.name: FindComponent
commands.description: Find a component by designator and zoom to it
